cards.label: Bermondsey - James's workshop
cards.text: Monday. Archie has pushed two benches together and called it a boardroom. Owen has been given a chair again.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Board meeting. Every Monday. Three pitches, you pick one, we see how it went next week. Nobody gets fired."

choices.label: Leave it to Archie
choices.result_text: "You weren't there, so you're doing mine."

cards.text: Any other business. James asks that the benches be put back exactly where they were.
